description: Land Acquisition - Dehiwala, Mount Lavinia Municipal Council Limits, Ratmalana
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed description of a specific land parcel (location, extent, boundaries, cadastral details) and outlines the legal process for acquisition, including notice to claimants and compensation procedures. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
